candidates.name: Full pack KBD runtime v1.17.0
candidates.decision_rationale: Use the same released event semantics as the writer and keep the four pack crates at one revision.

evidence.claim: Companion pins the older common revision cfbc262.

risks: Other event variants and dependency changes require verification with actual signed histories.

candidates.name: Full pack KBD CLI read and retry paths
candidates.decision_rationale: Keep the current CLI and make local fallback observable when the operator requested a remote read.

evidence.claim: Status, audit and watch have distinct remote read and fallback paths.
When the requested socket was absent status/audit succeeded silently and watch exited 1.

risks: Changing stdout framing would break scripts.
A blanket fallback on any remote read error can mask denial or schema incompatibility with a successful local response.

candidates.name: Full pack agent-team handoff
candidates.decision_rationale: Use the existing durable packet and explicit recipient acceptance.

evidence.claim: The destination explicitly accepts a revision-checked handoff.

risks: Referenced checkout files and attachments need their own availability check.
Acceptance is atomic in one authoritative local team-state file. A copied packet or journal on B cannot transfer ownership at A; network-share or multi-machine writes are unsupported.

candidates.name: iroh and Companion addressed peer transport
candidates.decision_rationale: Reuse the locked QUIC implementation and the existing application-level checks.

evidence.claim: iroh supports direct communication with a named endpoint.
The transport verifies remote public-key identity.
Locked 1.1.0 is published and not yanked.
The directed receive path distinguishes transport admission from application.

risks: Pairing alone does not enroll a project device.
Same-host checks cannot establish physical LAN discovery.

candidates.name: Loro and KBD signed project updates
candidates.decision_rationale: Retain the existing document model. Measure full-history transfer before deciding whether incremental payloads are needed.

evidence.claim: Document export supports full or receiver-relative updates.
Locked 1.13.9 is published and not yanked.

risks: Signed KBD event validity is an application responsibility.
Encoded frame sizes may exceed the bounded transport.

build_required.need: Pin and verify the supported writer/reader pair
build_required.why_no_candidate: Dependency selection and signed fixture compatibility belong to the two projects.

build_required.need: Identify the actual read source and support watcher recovery
build_required.why_no_candidate: Only the CLI can preserve its output contracts and distinguish a local fallback.

build_required.need: Verify receiver application, failure isolation, scale and restart
build_required.why_no_candidate: An upstream transport receipt cannot attest to this application’s durable history and waypoint.

build_required.need: Recover when a durable import advances the journal but refreshing the checkout fails
build_required.why_no_candidate: The runtime has comparison and projection-writing APIs. Companion logs the refresh error and returns success; retries with zero new events skip the refresh. The integration must detect or expose this condition and exercise recovery.
